query: SELECT jsonb_build_array((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(a) ORDER BY id) FROM billing_payment_attempts a WHERE billing_scope_id = $1), (SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(c) ORDER BY id) FROM billing_processor_charges c WHERE billing_scope_id = $1), (SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(s) ORDER BY id) FROM billing_subscriptions s WHERE billing_scope_id = $1))::text
